Not quite $10k but just as interesting I hope, when I was young I worked at a KFC and we had this Star Wars promotion where they displayed life size figurines of the main characters in all the stores. In our store was a very imposing Darth Maul right next to the front counter standing over the crowds of people desperate for their chicken fix each day.

One night I happen to be working out the back when one of the front counter girls comes running back very scared and panicked. I thought we were being robbed and went for the most imposing thing I could find, a heavy steel hook for lifting chicken out of the friers. Turns out that a couple of guys walked in, picked up Mr Maul, carried him out to the back of their ute and drove off not even saying a word.

The usual things then happened, the police come out to do a report (and received bags of free chicken for their time) and the story appeared in the local rag. The figurines were being auctioned off for charity and this theft would mean one would miss out.

A couple of days later the guys return Darth and are very apologetic. They saw all the stories and felt bad and said it was just a prank gone wrong. I don't know if they were prosecuted or whatever, but I'd imagine a life size Darth Maul in your loungeroom would look pretty suspicious.
